gen-irish-grover-gf-lexend-giga: Irish Grover looks sturdy and a bit goofy, its tall lowercase softly modulated. Lexend Giga sits beneath it with flat, uniform lines and generous tracking, so the wobbly top and the measured bottom keep each other honest.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads large and sturdy, its tall lowercase and open e making words easy to grasp. Yet Azonix is the one that commands, wide-mouthed capitals in a flat, unvarying line, while the body simply carries the sentences.
gen-luckiest-guy-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp and heavy, a thick strip of text with letters held open rather than curled shut. And Luckiest Guy is the loud one, poured at one width, so give it plenty of size above that plain sans.
gen-megrim-satoshi: Megrim's hairline angles, every stroke ending at the same measured thickness, give it a futuristic edge. But Satoshi does the everyday work, with a soaring x-height and an open e that never looks squeezed.
gen-mystery-quest-switzer: Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve and a bookish, nostalgic lean. And Switzer would carry a long passage smoothly, its wire-like letters and tall waist line keeping every line light and approachable.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-julius-sans-one: A mean line set high, with ink that looks poured at one width, makes Luckiest Guy cheerfully loud. Julius Sans One reads spacious and light, with wide gaps between letters.
gen-tourney-satoshi: Tourney stretches its words with wide tracking and bulky small letters. Satoshi does the quieter job, its soaring x-height and open e giving long text an approachable, easy flow.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-tera: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets its glyphs apart with wide grout lines and no thick-thin shift. Lexend Tera, drawn like a plotter pen, would read with stepping-stone spacing.
gen-eater-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta has a big x-height, curves without any thinning, and a signage-like plainness in every line weight. Eater, dark and aggressive, adds wide gaps and a middling spread of heavy and light.
gen-flavors-gf-lexend-mega: Stubby, towering, a touch whimsical: Flavors has diagonals as heavy as its stems. Lexend Mega would read in a steady one-nib line, its body height nearly matching the capitals.
